panels.title: Collect-Earnings: source + rules
panels.body:
**Finnhub calendar/earnings**, one call per ticker, 1.1 s apart (60/min free tier), about a minute for the watchlist. Window: 100 days back for the last reported quarter and its surprise, 120 days forward for the next date.
**Stored** in intel.earnings_calendar: report_date, hour (bmo before open, amc after close), EPS and revenue estimate vs actual, surprise_pct = (actual - estimate) / |estimate|.
**Moved dates**: companies reschedule, so unreported future rows are cleared for every ticker that answered before the upsert. A ticker whose call failed keeps what it had.
**No coverage** is normal for recent listings and some small caps; they come back in `no_date` so the brief can say the date is unknown instead of implying there is none. Benchmarks (ETFs) are skipped.

zones.title: Fan out + fetch
zones.body: One item per non-ETF ticker. neverError with the full response: a bad reply becomes a ledger row, not a crash.

zones.title: Normalize + store
zones.body: Rows keyed ticker + report_date. One transaction: clear moved dates, upsert, one intel.api_usage row per call.

zones.title: Return
zones.body: Counts, failed tickers and the no-date list go back to Daily for the run status and the brief.
